title: Smooth cutoff with derivative bounds
statement: For every natural number $m$, real number $u$, and real number $\eta>0$, there is a function $\phi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ of class $C^{m+1}$ taking values in $[0,1]$, equal to $1$ for $x\le u$ and equal to $0$ for $x\ge u+(m+2)\eta$. Moreover, its $(m+1)$st derivative satisfies $|\phi^{(m+1)}(x)|\le 2^m/\eta^{m+1}$ for every real $x$.
